summary: SkyAI, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) disclosing that its Board formed a special committee of independent directors to evaluate an unsolicited, non-binding all-stock business combination proposal from Forward Industries, Inc. The special committee and Board unanimously concluded the proposal was against shareholder interests, confirming SkyAI is not pursuing the transaction. No price per share, valuation, premium, advisor, or deal mechanics were provided. The filing is a rejection, not a consummated deal. Watch for alternative suitors or operational updates; no risk-arb angle applies without a definitive agreement.
